summary: Banco Santander (Brasil) filed a 6-K updating its July 30, 2026 material fact: parent Banco Santander, S.A. filed for CVM registration as a foreign issuer, registered a BDR program and B3 listing, registered the Brazilian Exchange Offer, and filed an F-4 with the SEC, not yet effective. UBS BB delivered the appraisal report for the Brazilian leg. The offer is a voluntary share exchange by the Offeror for Santander Brasil. No price, ratio, premium or dates stated; watch CVM/SEC effectiveness, appraisal fairness and BDR liquidity.
